passage:
panel — 专家小组；讨论小组
On a rainy Tuesday in March, a small panel met in a community hall in Bristol.

adapt — 适应；调整
It was a group of five people who had agreed to compare how different teams adapt when plans go wrong.

improvise — 临时应对；即兴发挥
Patel said, “We lost the baked potatoes, but we kept the service.” The panel noted that this strategy was “improvise with what you have.” It worked because the team had clear roles and quick communication.

deadline — 截止日期
Two weeks before the deadline, the client asked for a major change.

essential — 必要的；本质的
The panel called this strategy “reduce scope, protect the core.” By focusing on essential features, the team delivered a functional product and maintained client satisfaction.

forecast — 预报
Two days before the festival, the weather forecast changed.

volunteer — 志愿者
The third case was about a volunteer group that organized a street festival.

uncertainty — 不确定性
Each case described a team facing uncertainty.
